'''Abomination Parasites''' are a ubiquitous tier of [[Mobs#Parasites|Parasites]]. Their Tier is subjective within their Hierarchy and contains 2 Mobs.

=== ''Properties'' ===
Most Abomination Parasites have their own custom property values; see their individual pages for more information.
